detail.readme:
An AI job application bot: automated job search, then it auto-applies to the jobs that match your resume, while you sleep.

FEATURED IN
Business Insider · TechCrunch · Semafor · Wired · The Verge · Vanity Fair · 404 Media
--- ## How it works Give it your resume. The job search finds the postings that fit, you pick, and it fills in and sends each job application on the company's own form. | Step | What happens | |---|---| | **1. Reads your resume** | Turns it into a search: the titles, the skills and the places that fit you. | | **2. Searches** | 10 million postings from 37 public sources, rebuilt every five hours, searched on your computer. | | **3. Scores** | Asks of every posting, against your resume, one question: is it in line with you? How sure the answer is makes the score, from 1 to 5. 50 jobs to a page, the next one ready while you read this one. | | **4. You pick** | Select the jobs you want and say yes once. | | **5. Applies** | A real Firefox opens the company's form, fills every required field, attaches your CV and sends. | | **6. Keeps the answer** | What each page said, with a screenshot, for every application. | --- ## Install Windows, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/feder-cr/Jobs_Applier_AI_Agent/main/run.ps1 | iex ``` Linux: ```bash curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/feder-cr/Jobs_Applier_AI_Agent/main/run.sh | sh ``` You need a key: [get one from OrcaRouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/ref/ref_accd17afb78fc95ac4d7). ## The count AIHawk tells us how it is used, so we know what to fix. It sends these events to [PostHog](https://posthog.com), with a random id made on your computer the first time, so each computer counts once: | Event | When | What it carries | |---|---|---| | `app_started` | AIHawk opens | AIHawk's version, the operating system | | `search` | a search ends | how many jobs it found | | `jobs_scored` | Jev reads a round | how many postings, how many it answered for, how long it took, the model | | `application` | an application ends | how it went (sent, refused, blocked, failed), why in one word (captcha, login, closed posting…), the kind of site (Workday, Greenhouse…), the models, the gateway, the steps, the time, and the tokens each model read and wrote | Nothing about you or the jobs goes with them: no name, email, resume, answer, company or link. The number on the badge above is the applications sent. The count is always on; a dry run is not counted. --- [Sites](docs/sites.md) · [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) · [Writing a plugin](docs/plugins.md) · [Wiki](https://github.com/feder-cr/Jobs_Applier_AI_Agent/wiki) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
